rationales.authenticity: Valerian and lemon balm are period-accurate, 'Tis and ye establish Irish voice.
rationales.character: Midwife's concern and herbal knowledge shine, though somewhat formulaic in structure.
rationales.craft: Evocative opening ('heavy burden, carrying those shadows') but slightly longer than ideal.
rationales.language: Clean en-IE dialect with natural Irish phrases; well-formed prose.
rationales.responsiveness: Directly addresses sleep trouble and offers remedy; internal note adds depth.
